messages.subject: Tessaract / HX-218 — technical pack
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

As discussed, the key technical facts: batch TX-HX218-0461 delivered 5 Aug with a clean CoA. We released it into lot DP-2025-114. On 2 Sep our release testing flagged an unknown impurity at 0.9% area (limit 0.5%). OOS-2025-037 traced it to the API, and Wraysbury confirmed it's a degradant from an unqualified starting material.

On 19 Sep Gerald Doyle at Tessaract admitted on a call that they'd switched the 4-chloro intermediate to Reyland Fine Chemicals with no change control. I've put the CoA, the OOS report and the Wraysbury report in the secure data room; let me know if you want anything else.

Stephen
